zh-TW: 營業收入占資產總計比重

note.zh-TW: 0-2 的簡化版用期末值，計算器統一期間並標示是否年化。
note.en: The 0-2 version uses closing values; the calculator aligns the periods and says whether figures are annualised.

definition.zh-TW: 全部資產能帶出多少營業收入，看資產運用的效率。次數越高表示資產運用越有效率；它也是杜邦分析的中間因子。
definition.en: How much revenue all the assets generate: the efficiency of asset use. Higher means the assets are worked harder; it is also the middle factor in the DuPont analysis.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
